navigation.latency_slow: Navigation tick takes %d ms at the median (about 110 ms is normal): screencap %d ms, image processing %d ms, localization %d ms, steering input %d ms, everything else %d ms. At this speed turns come too late, so the character tends to hit walls or fall into water. Try lowering the in-game graphics quality and resolution, closing heavy background programs, and checking whether GPU usage is too high. This notice does not interrupt the task.
navigation.sensitivity_mismatch: Navigation is consistently over-rotating: measured turns reach about %d%% of the commanded angle, where roughly 100%% is expected; this figure is the median over the last %d samples. Over-rotation makes navigation correct its heading repeatedly, which can lead to hitting walls or falling into water. This is usually caused by raised in-game camera sensitivity; restoring the default value should resolve it. This notice does not stop the task.
